'''Shogo Sakata''' (Japanese: '''坂田将吾''' ''Sakata Shōgo'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sakata was born on January 23, 1998 in {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing several Pokémon, his most notable role being that of [[Goh's Inteleon]].
